name: Diana Shnaider
intro: Diana Shnaider is a lefty. She swings with her left hand. You can spot her by her colorful bandana. She is 22 and already has an Olympic medal. This spring she reached the final four at the French Open.
story: Diana started tennis at age four. At 18 she went to college in North Carolina. She won almost every match. Then she turned pro and shot up the rankings. At the Paris Olympics she won a silver medal in doubles. She won two matches here in New York this year. On Friday she battled for three sets. Next time, look for that bandana!

funFacts.text: She plays in a bandana instead of a cap. She started as a kid to avoid sunburn.
Her favorite movie is Never Back Down. Her favorite food is Asian food.
Her mom is an English teacher. Her dad is a lawyer who used to be a boxer.
She played one season of college tennis at NC State. She won 20 matches and lost only 3.
She won Olympic silver in doubles with her partner Mirra Andreeva.
At the 2026 French Open she was way behind. She came back to beat the world No. 1.
She is a lefty. Lefties make the ball spin the other way. That can surprise opponents.

watchFor: Spot her bandana, then notice she holds the racket in her left hand.
